sweep.title: Field Sweep Analysis
sweep.windowNoneRange: Window exists above sweep range. Expand to ~{max} {unit} to find it.
sweep.windowNoneImpossible: No window possible at current settings (max TI: {ti}×). Try lower frequency or wider pulses.
sweep.windowNoneCounterSelective: Counter-selective regime: target cell is LESS disrupted than healthy at every point (max TI: {ti}×). The healthy cell has a higher Vm or lower threshold. Try a different cell pairing or resonance mode.
sweep.tipSweepLabel: Sweep Parameter Choose the physical quantity to vary on the x-axis.
sweep.tipFieldPill: E-field Sweep Varies field 0 → max at fixed RF frequency. Reveals minimum lysis field and selectivity window.
sweep.tipFreqPill: Frequency Sweep Varies RF frequency 0 → max at fixed field. Shows Schwan roll-off and fc-dependent selectivity. Note: SAR is frequency-independent in this model.
sweep.tipMaxLabel: Sweep Maximum ({unit}) Upper limit of the sweep axis. Increase to reveal higher operating points.
sweep.tipExport: ↓ Export CSV Download all sweep data points. Columns: x · DR_H · DR_T · TI · T_H · T_T · selective_window selective_window=1 only when DR_T≥85% AND DR_H<50% AND T_target<60°C.
sweep.tipChart: Field Sweep Chart Red = Target DR · Cyan = Healthy DR Amber dashed = TI (right axis) Green fill = Selectivity window White cursor = current active value
sweep.tipThDrT: DR_T, Target Disruption Ratio Target DR at this operating point. DR = Vm × f_pulse / V_threshold 1.0 = lysis threshold crossed
sweep.tipThDrH: DR_H, Healthy Disruption Ratio Healthy DR at the same operating point. Keep below 0.50 for a safe selectivity window.
